words.note: 控制自己的情緒、衝動與行為，尤其是當下不被誘惑或情緒牽着走。

falseSynonyms.zh: self-control 更聚焦當下衝動或情緒；discipline 還常包含長期規律。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She used self-control and did not answer angrily. She needs discipline to follow the study routine every day.

falseSynonyms.zh: determination 是「一定要做到」；discipline 還包括如何規律地管理自己。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON His determination made him keep trying after failure. His discipline made him practise at the same time every morning.

falseSynonyms.zh: motivation 是想做的動力；discipline 是即使不想做也能照做。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Motivation made her excited to start exercising. Discipline kept her exercising after the excitement faded.

falseSynonyms.zh: obedience 是服從外部命令；discipline 可以完全由自己產生。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The dog showed obedience to its trainer's commands. The athlete showed discipline by training alone every morning.

falseSynonyms.zh: 本課的 discipline 是自律，不等於 punishment。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The school imposed punishment for repeated cheating. Studying consistently requires personal discipline.

falseSynonyms.zh: restraint 可指自我克制，也可指外在約束；self-discipline 明確是自己管理自己。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He showed restraint and did not reply angrily. She relied on self-discipline to complete the work without supervision.

falseSynonyms.zh: habit 是已自動化的重複行為；discipline 是在需要努力時仍守住計劃。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Checking the calendar each morning became a habit. It took discipline to build that habit in the first place.

falseSynonyms.zh: discipline 是名詞或動詞；disciplined 是形容詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The job requires discipline. She is a highly disciplined worker.
